image_prompts: Factory chimneys release thick black smoke, darkening the sky.
A person sits on a park bench smoking, with a no-smoking sign clearly visible.
words.image_desc_en: Factory chimneys emitting thick smoke, darkening the sky.
words.image_desc_cn: 工厂烟囱冒出滚滚浓烟，天空变得灰暗。
words.collocations: smoke a cigarette, stop smoking, thick smoke, smoke alarm
words.preposition_combos: from (the smoke), in (the smoke), through (the smoke)

examples.en: You are not allowed to smoke in the classroom.
examples.cn: 教室里不允许抽烟。

examples.en: Thick black smoke was rising from the factory chimney.
examples.cn: 浓黑的烟从工厂烟囱里升起。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么公共场所要禁止吸烟？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 烟雾不仅伤害吸烟者自己，还会污染空气，让周围人吸入二手烟。

sentences: The burning building gave off a lot of black ___.

image_prompts: A girl getting her ears pierced at a jewelry shop.
A needle piercing through a piece of cloth.
words.image_desc_en: A young girl sits in a chair while a professional pierces her earlobe with a piercing gun.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个年轻女孩坐在椅子上，专业人员用穿耳枪刺穿她的耳垂。
words.collocations: pierce the sky, pierce the silence, pierce one's ears

examples.en: She pierced her ears to wear earrings for the party.
examples.cn: 她为了参加派对穿了耳洞戴耳环。

examples.en: The needle pierced his skin easily, drawing a drop of blood.
examples.cn: 针轻松刺破了他的皮肤，渗出一滴血。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么有时我们会说一个人有‘piercing eyes’？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 形容目光非常锐利，像能刺穿事物一样。

sentences: The loud noise ___ the quietness of the night.

image_prompts: A teenager holding a new driver's license and smiling.
A close-up of a license with a photo and expiration date.
words.image_desc_en: A happy teenage boy shows his newly issued driver's license to his friends.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个开心的少年男孩向朋友们展示他新拿到的驾照。
words.collocations: driver's license, license plate, marriage license, license number

examples.en: You need a driver's license to drive a car legally.
examples.cn: 你需要驾照才能合法开车。

examples.en: She got a fishing license to fish in the lake near her home.
examples.cn: 她办了钓鱼证，可以在家附近的湖里钓鱼。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么未成年人不能拿驾照？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为他们的判断力、反应能力还不够成熟，容易出危险。

sentences: He forgot his ___ at home, so the police officer gave him a warning.

image_prompts: Students wearing safety goggles in a science lab.
A worker wearing a safety helmet on a construction site.
words.image_desc_en: A group of students wearing safety goggles and conducting an experiment in a laboratory.
words.image_desc_cn: 一群学生戴着安全护目镜在实验室做实验。
words.collocations: safety belt, safety rules, safety first, in safety

examples.en: We should follow safety rules in the chemistry lab.
examples.cn: 在化学实验室我们应该遵守安全规则。

examples.en: The police officer ensured the children's safety on the street.
examples.cn: 警察确保了街道上孩子们的安全。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么过马路时我们特别强调安全？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为不遵守交通规则很容易发生事故，造成伤害。

sentences: Please fasten your ___ belt before the plane takes off.

image_prompts: A girl putting on a sparkling diamond earring in front of a mirror.
A baby wearing a small gold earring for cultural reasons.
words.image_desc_en: A teenage girl carefully puts a silver earring into her left earlobe while looking at her reflection.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个十几岁的女孩一边看着镜子中的自己，一边小心翼翼地把一只银耳环戴在左耳垂上。
words.collocations: gold earring, a pair of earrings, diamond earrings

examples.en: My mother gave me a pair of earrings for my birthday.
examples.cn: 妈妈送我一对耳环作为生日礼物。

examples.en: She lost one of her earrings on the bus and felt unhappy.
examples.cn: 她在公交车上丢了一只耳环，很不开心。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么有些女生喜欢戴耳环？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 为了装饰自己，让自己看起来更漂亮或有个性。

sentences: She wears a beautiful ___ on each ear.

image_prompts: A sad child crying with tears running down his cheeks.
A man crying out in pain after stubbing his toe.
words.image_desc_en: A young boy sits on the floor, crying loudly with his face buried in his hands.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个小男孩坐在地上，脸埋在手里大声哭泣。
words.collocations: cry out, cry for help, have a cry, cry over

examples.en: The baby cried for his mother when he fell down.
examples.cn: 宝宝摔倒后哭着找妈妈。

examples.en: Don't cry over spilt milk.
examples.cn: 覆水难收（不要为打翻的牛奶哭泣）。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么人们有时候会忍不住想哭？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为情绪太强烈，比如伤心、委屈或感动，身体自然用哭来释放。

sentences: She couldn't stop ___ when she heard the sad news.

image_prompts: A green field with tall grass and wildflowers under a blue sky, children running and laughing.
A soccer field with two teams playing, a white goal in the background.
words.image_desc_en: A wide field of green grass and wildflowers under a bright sky, kids playing.
words.image_desc_cn: 一片绿草和野花覆盖的宽阔田野，天空晴朗，孩子们在玩耍。
words.collocations: field trip, field of study, soccer field, field of view
words.preposition_combos: in the field, on the field, across the field

examples.en: We went to a farm and played in the field after the harvest.
examples.cn: 收割后我们去了农场，在田野里玩耍。

examples.en: She is an expert in the field of environmental science.
examples.cn: 她是环境科学领域的专家。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在写作文时想形容“在运动场上比赛”，你会用field还是ground？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想field通常指有明确用途的场地，比如足球场、田野；ground更泛指地面。

sentences: The students went on a ___ trip to observe plants and insects.

image_prompts: A little girl hugging her grandfather tightly, both smiling.
Two friends hugging after a long time, tears of joy in their eyes.
words.image_desc_en: A girl hugging an old man closely, both faces full of happiness.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个小女孩紧紧拥抱一位老人，两人的脸上都洋溢着幸福。
words.collocations: give a hug, hug tightly, warm hug, bear hug

examples.en: After winning the game, the coach gave each player a big hug.
examples.cn: 赢得比赛后，教练给了每个队员一个大大的拥抱。

examples.en: When I was sad, my best friend hugged me and said everything would be okay.
examples.cn: 我难过时，好朋友拥抱了我，说一切都会好起来的。

socratic_questions.question: 你会在什么情况下主动给朋友一个hug？为什么拥抱有时比说话更温暖？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想拥抱能表达安慰、喜悦或感谢，是一种非语言的沟通。

sentences: She ran to her mother and gave her a warm ___.

image_prompts: A boy lifting a heavy box onto a shelf with effort.
A group of students lifting a fallen tree branch to clear the path.
words.image_desc_en: A young man straining to lift a cardboard box onto a high shelf.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个年轻男子费力地把纸箱举到一个高架子上。
words.collocations: lift up, lift weights, lift the box, lift one's spirits
words.preposition_combos: lift onto, lift from, lift up

examples.en: Please help me lift the desk to the second floor.
examples.cn: 请帮我把这张桌子搬到二楼。

examples.en: The good news lifted everyone's mood.
examples.cn: 这个好消息提振了大家的情绪。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么我们说“lifting weights”而不说“lifting books”？这里的lift和举重的lift有什么区别？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 注意语境：lift weights是固定健身用语，而lift + 物体是泛指举起。

sentences: Can you ___ this heavy suitcase for me?

image_prompts: A child with crossed arms, frowning and saying something to an adult in a kitchen.
A teenager rolling eyes while a parent is talking, posture of defiance.
words.image_desc_en: A young child facing an adult with a stubborn expression, lips moving as if arguing.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个小孩面对大人，表情固执，嘴巴在动像是在争辩。
words.usage: 短语动词 回嘴；顶嘴
words.collocations: talk back to someone, don't talk back, never talk back

examples.en: Mom told me not to talk back when she was explaining the rules.
examples.cn: 妈妈解释规则时，不许我顶嘴。

examples.en: In many cultures, it's considered rude for children to talk back to their elders.
examples.cn: 在很多文化里，孩子对长辈顶嘴被认为是不礼貌的。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你和朋友发生争执，你“talk back”和“explain your point of view”有什么区别？哪个更容易被接受？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 思考：talk back常带对立情绪，而explain是理性沟通。

sentences: The teacher warned the student not to ___ ___ in class.

image_prompts: A student looking at a test paper with a red F, face full of disappointment.
A rainy day with flooded streets, a person soaked and shivering.
words.image_desc_en: A teenager staring at a failing grade on a test paper, shoulders slumped.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个青少年盯着试卷上的不及格分数，垂头丧气。
words.usage: adj. 很坏的；讨厌的；极度的
words.collocations: awful weather, awful taste, awful experience, awful mistake

examples.en: The cafeteria served awful food today; no one could finish it.
examples.cn: 今天食堂的饭菜糟透了，没人能吃完。

examples.en: I had an awful headache after studying for hours without a break.
examples.cn: 连续学习几个小时后，我头痛得厉害。

socratic_questions.question: awful和bad有什么区别？为什么awful的语气更强烈？你能造一个用awful形容心情的句子吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: awful程度远超bad，类似“极差”。比如：I feel awful for forgetting her birthday. 表示极度内疚。

sentences: The movie was so ___ that we left the theater after 20 minutes.

image_prompts: A group of teens laughing together in a school hallway.
A teen sitting alone on a park bench reading a book.
words.image_desc_en: Teens in a school hallway and a teen reading on a bench
words.image_desc_cn: 学校走廊里的青少年们和一个在长椅上看书的青少年
words.usage: n. 十几岁的青少年（13-19岁）
words.collocations: teen years, teen angst, teen drama, rebellious teen

examples.en: Many teens enjoy hanging out with friends after school.
examples.cn: 很多青少年放学后喜欢和朋友出去玩。

examples.en: As a teen, she started writing poems in a small notebook.
examples.cn: 作为一个十几岁的青少年，她开始在一个小笔记本上写诗。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么青少年有时被称为“teens”？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：考虑“teen”这个词与数字13到19的关系。

sentences: He is a ___，just like many kids his age.

image_prompts: A student looking regretfully at a low test score.
A person shaking their head with a regretful expression.
words.image_desc_en: Regretful student and a person with regret
words.image_desc_cn: 后悔的学生和一个表现后悔的人
words.collocations: regret doing, deeply regret, regret to say, regret that

examples.en: I regret not studying harder for the math test.
examples.cn: 我后悔没有为数学考试更努力学习。

examples.en: She regretted buying such expensive shoes.
examples.cn: 她后悔买了这么贵的鞋子。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么“regret”后面常常跟动名词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：注意表示对已做或未做的事情感到遗憾。

sentences: I ___ telling her the truth.

image_prompts: An open book with a handwritten poem on a desk.
A student reciting a poem in front of the class.
words.image_desc_en: Handwritten poem on paper and a student reciting
words.image_desc_cn: 写在纸上的手写诗和一个朗诵诗的学生
words.collocations: write a poem, read a poem, love poem, famous poem

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to write a poem about spring.
examples.cn: 老师让我们写一首关于春天的诗。

examples.en: He recited a famous poem by Li Bai at the party.
examples.cn: 他在聚会上朗诵了一首李白的著名诗。

socratic_questions.question: 诗歌和散文有什么不同？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：注意诗歌有韵律和节奏，而散文没有。

sentences: She wrote a beautiful ___ about friendship.

image_prompts: A cozy bedroom with a bed, desk, and soft lighting.
Two kids playing in a bedroom with toys on the floor.
words.image_desc_en: Cozy bedroom interior and kids playing in a bedroom
words.image_desc_cn: 舒适的卧室内部和在卧室里玩耍的孩子们
words.collocations: master bedroom, clean the bedroom, bedroom furniture, shared bedroom

examples.en: I always make my bed in the morning in my bedroom.
examples.cn: 我每天早上在卧室整理床铺。

examples.en: My sister and I share a bedroom with two beds.
examples.cn: 我和姐姐共用一间有两张床的卧室。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么卧室通常被称为最私人的房间？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：想想你在卧室里做什么，比如睡觉、换衣服等。

sentences: Please go to your ___ and finish your homework.

image_prompts: A group of volunteers planting trees in a community park.
A community center with people of all ages gathering.
words.image_desc_en: Volunteers planting trees and a community center gathering
words.image_desc_cn: 志愿者们在社区公园植树和社区中心的人群聚集
words.collocations: local community, community service, community center, community members

examples.en: Our school organized a community clean-up day last Saturday.
examples.cn: 我们学校上周六组织了一次社区清洁日。

examples.en: She is well-known in the local community for her volunteer work.
examples.cn: 她因志愿工作在当地社区很有名。

socratic_questions.question: 社区和社团有什么联系？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：社区是由共同特征（如居住地、兴趣）的人们组成的群体。

sentences: The whole ___ came together to help the family after the fire.

image_prompts: Students keeping away from a wet floor in school corridor.
A child keeping away from a stray dog on the street.
words.image_desc_en: Students avoiding a wet floor in a school hallway.
words.image_desc_cn: 学生们在走廊里避开湿滑的地面。
words.usage: 短语 verb phrase; 表示避免接近或远离
words.collocations: keep away from fire, keep away from strangers, keep away from trouble, keep away from danger

examples.en: You should keep away from the wet floor.
examples.cn: 你应该远离湿地。

examples.en: Keep away from bad habits to stay healthy.
examples.cn: 远离坏习惯以保持健康。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么在图书馆里我们要保持安静并远离大声说话的人？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为大声会打扰别人学习。

sentences: The teacher told the students to ___ the dangerous chemicals in the lab.

image_prompts: A student excitedly grabbing a chance to answer a question in class.
A person taking a chance by applying for a challenging job.
words.image_desc_en: A student raising hand eagerly to answer a question in class.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个学生积极举手回答问题。
words.usage: n. 可数名词，表示机会或可能性；常与不定冠词a连用，如a chance to do sth.
words.collocations: have a chance, take a chance, miss a chance, get a chance

examples.en: I finally got a chance to speak English with a foreigner.
examples.cn: 我终于有机会和外国人讲英语了。

examples.en: She never misses a chance to learn something new.
examples.cn: 她从不错过学习新东西的机会。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有一次免费环游世界的机会，但需要克服很多困难，你会接受吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想这个机会可能给你带来什么改变。

sentences: He didn't study hard, so he missed the ___ to go to his dream university.

image_prompts: A teenager confidently making her own decision about what clothes to wear.
A young man deciding his college major by himself.
words.image_desc_en: A girl choosing clothes in front of a mirror with a determined look.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个女孩在镜子前坚定地选择衣服。
words.usage: 短语 verb phrase; 意为“自己做决定”，常与情态动词连用，如should/must make one's own decision
words.collocations: make a wise decision, make a quick decision, make a difficult decision, make a choice

examples.en: As teenagers, we should learn to make our own decisions.
examples.cn: 作为青少年，我们应该学会自己做决定。

examples.en: It's important to make your own decision about which career to choose.
examples.cn: 关于选择什么职业，自己做决定很重要。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你爸妈想让你学钢琴，但你想学画画，你会怎么做？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想如何表达自己的想法并做出自己的决定。

sentences: Now that you are 18, you can ___ about your future.

image_prompts: A student managing to solve a complex math problem on the blackboard.
A young lady managing a busy office desk efficiently.
words.image_desc_en: A student writing on a blackboard with a confident posture.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个学生在黑板上自信地解题。
words.meaning_cn: 设法做到；应付（困难局面）
words.usage: v. 动词，意为设法做到或应付；常接不定式，如manage to do sth.
words.collocations: manage to do, manage something, manage without, manage with

examples.en: He managed to finish his homework before dinner.
examples.cn: 他设法在晚饭前完成了作业。

examples.en: She can manage the difficult situation all by herself.
examples.cn: 她可以独自应付这个困难局面。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你的小组项目遇到困难，你会如何设法完成？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 考虑分工合作或者寻求帮助。

sentences: Although it was hard, she ___ to pass the exam with high scores.

image_prompts: People from different walks of life interacting in a busy city.
Volunteers helping clean up a park for the benefit of society.
words.image_desc_en: A busy city street with diverse people going about their daily activities.
words.image_desc_cn: 繁忙的街道上各行各业的人们进行日常活动。
words.usage: n. 名词，通常不可数，表示社会整体；也可作可数，如a modern society
words.collocations: modern society, human society, a part of society, in society

examples.en: We should all be responsible members of society.
examples.cn: 我们都应该成为负责任的社会成员。

examples.en: Technology has changed every aspect of society.
examples.cn: 技术改变了社会的方方面面。

socratic_questions.question: 你认为一个人对社会的最大贡献是什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想不同职业的人如何为社会服务。

sentences: Everyone plays an important role in ___.

image_prompts: A student pointing to 'Unit 5' on the table of contents of an English textbook.
A scale with a kilogram weight and a label saying 'unit of mass'.
words.image_desc_en: A student points to 'Unit 5' in a textbook's table of contents; a scale displays a kilogram weight with the label 'unit of mass'.
words.image_desc_cn: 一名学生指着英语课本目录中的第五单元；一台秤上显示一公斤重的砝码和“质量单位”标签。
words.collocations: a unit of, family unit, unit test, unit price

examples.en: Please turn to Unit 3 in your textbook and read the dialogue.
examples.cn: 请翻到课本第三单元，阅读对话。

examples.en: A kilogram is a unit of weight used in science.
examples.cn: 千克是科学中使用的重量单位。

socratic_questions.question: 在我们学过的知识中，什么可以被看作一个‘单元’？举一个例子。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 比如课本中的一个单元、家庭、或一个系统里的基本组成部分。

sentences: In our English textbook, each ___ has a different topic and grammar focus.

image_prompts: A teacher writing on a blackboard with students raising their hands in a classroom.
A documentary screen showing a polar bear on melting ice with text 'Educate to Save the Arctic'.
words.image_desc_en: A teacher writes on the board while students raise hands; a documentary shows a polar bear and the message 'Educate to Save the Arctic'.
words.image_desc_cn: 老师在黑板上写字，学生举手；纪录片画面是北极熊和标语“教育拯救北极”。
words.collocations: educate children, educate the public, educate oneself, well-educated

examples.en: Teachers work hard to educate students in the classroom.
examples.cn: 老师们在教室里努力教育学生。

examples.en: We should educate ourselves about how to protect the environment.
examples.cn: 我们应该教育自己如何保护环境。

socratic_questions.question: 除了在学校，别人还能通过哪些方式‘教育’我们？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 比如父母的言传身教、看纪录片、参加讲座等。

sentences: The program aims to ___ young people about the dangers of smoking.

image_prompts: A student trying to study while a video game controller is placed on the open textbook.
A fallen tree blocking a road with a sign reading 'Road Closed'.
words.image_desc_en: A student studies with a video game controller on the textbook; a fallen tree blocks a road with a 'Road Closed' sign.
words.image_desc_cn: 一名学生在学习，课本上放着一个游戏手柄；一棵倒下的树挡住马路，旁边有“道路封闭”标志。
words.collocations: get in the way of progress, get in the way of learning, get in the way of dreams, get in the way of success

examples.en: Don't let your phone get in the way of your homework.
examples.cn: 别让手机妨碍你做作业。

examples.en: His laziness got in the way of his goal to become a doctor.
examples.cn: 他的懒惰阻碍了他成为医生的目标。

socratic_questions.question: 你觉得什么事情最容易‘妨碍’你提高英语成绩？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 比如玩游戏、看电视太多、缺乏练习等。

sentences: Playing video games too much can ___ your studies.

image_prompts: A basketball player in uniform signing autographs for fans.
A doctor in a white coat using a stethoscope to examine a patient.
words.image_desc_en: A basketball player signs autographs; a doctor examines a patient with a stethoscope.
words.image_desc_cn: 一名篮球运动员在签名；一位医生用听诊器检查病人。
words.collocations: professional athlete, professional advice, professional skills, professional work

examples.en: Many students dream of becoming a professional basketball player.
examples.cn: 很多学生梦想成为职业篮球运动员。

examples.en: You should ask a professional doctor for advice about your health.
examples.cn: 你应该就健康问题咨询专业医生。

socratic_questions.question: 在哪些领域的人往往会被称为‘专业人士’？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 比如医生、律师、工程师——因为他们受过专门训练。

sentences: She took ___ training to become a teacher.

image_prompts: A student quietly opening the classroom door and stepping inside while others are reading.
A computer screen with a login box asking 'Enter your password'.
words.image_desc_en: A student enters a classroom quietly while others read; a login screen shows 'Enter your password'.
words.image_desc_cn: 一名学生安静地走进教室，其他人在读书；登录画面显示“输入密码”。
words.collocations: enter the room, enter a competition, enter the data, enter college

examples.en: Please enter the classroom quietly and take your seat.
examples.cn: 请安静地进入教室并坐好。

examples.en: She plans to enter a writing competition next month.
examples.cn: 她计划下个月参加一个写作比赛。

socratic_questions.question: 除了‘进入’房间，enter还可以用在什么场合？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 比如参加比赛、输入信息、进入某一阶段等。

sentences: You need to ___ your password to log in to the website.

image_prompts: A group of friends helping a teammate cross the finish line.
A student raising hand to show agreement in class.
words.image_desc_en: Friends supporting each other in a race.
words.image_desc_cn: 朋友们在比赛中互相支持。
words.usage: 动词：支持，帮助；名词：支持，帮助。
words.collocations: support sb/sth, support for, provide support, financial support

examples.en: My parents always support my decisions.
examples.cn: 我父母总是支持我的决定。

examples.en: The new evidence supports his argument.
examples.cn: 新证据支持他的论点。

socratic_questions.question: 当你想说你支持一个计划时，用哪个词？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 注意这个词既可以作动词也可以作名词。

sentences: Our team needs your ______ to win the game.
